dialogues.speaker: Zeitlind
dialogues.text: *coughing*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Zeitlind
dialogues.text: ...I'm fine. I just had a very, very long nightmare.

dialogues.speaker: Zeitlind
dialogues.text: ...Forget it. Pretend I didn't say that.

dialogues.speaker: Zeitlind
dialogues.text: I can't take it anymore. Why does this keep happening to me?

dialogues.speaker: Zeitlind
dialogues.text: Why is it always me... First Mom and Dad... and now my sister...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's okay. I'm here with you.

dialogues.speaker: Zeitlind
dialogues.text: ...I know. I'm not angry at you.

dialogues.speaker: Zeitlind
dialogues.text: What has Dex picked up?

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: I call it a Deathmuse Shard. It may be a way to move from death unto life.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Zeitlind
dialogues.text: Yes, let's.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Now that Zeitlind's been found, let's try to find a way out.

dialogues.speaker: Alara
dialogues.text: Are you sure we can get out of here by ourselves?

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Melanta and Nihilita can move within this place freely, and they usually bring people with them. In which case, Dex should be able to do the same.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: That's three Deathmuse Shards collected.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Though I should say this is a temporary name, since I have no clue what Dex will be using them for either.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: What next, Dex?

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Let's follow its directions.
